projection.scope: Only the two original reviewer-source identities in mappings are projected. No other file or manifest commitment is replaced or reauthorized.

verification_scope.public_verification: Pinned public derivative bytes and unchanged retained manifest commitments only; the derivative is not the original raw source.
verification_scope.custodian_private_comparison: The custodian observed byte equality of both original source copies, verified their existing commitment, and compared the derivative with the original JSON object after removing exactly its top-level /url member. This private comparison is not independently repeatable from the public derivative.
verification_scope.limitation: Public readers cannot recompute the SHA-256 of either withheld original source from the public derivative or this receipt. Original commitments remain historical commitments, not public re-verification of private bytes.
verification_scope.publication_boundary: Both mapped original source files remain local and are excluded from the separate public export. This receipt does not authorize release of private backups or enclosing repository history.
